vendor_cpm.basis: Native AMR routed-checkpoint export of 2026-09-24 retains scoped ip_cpm5.xdc RXUSRCLK case analysis and the exact 64 CPM5 hard-IP driver mappings. Compared with the 2026-09-15 audited export, only generated waiver timestamps and four HPU placement LOC lines changed. The digest excludes generated waiver timestamps and placement-only LOCs on hpu_3parts cells, while retaining all CPM commands, later overrides, and their order. The 2026-09-25 reroute added twelve HPU replica LOC lines and no other executable constraint changes. PCIe lanes are not claimed inactive.
